versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ledger-reporter-34129 profile sync client.
- Reads sync manifest from your account via a local background daemon.
- Uploads specified files as snapshots for profile restoration on new machines.
- Requires initialization with --init before first use.
- Files are capped at a configurable max size (default: 65536 bytes).
- Uses secure, owner-only Unix domain socket for service communication.
